context:
AGENTS.md is the front door for contributors and AI agents. It should
link out to depth, not contain it. Each new section: 2-5 sentences + a
link to the deep-dive in /docs/development/.

For tests/README.md, treat it as onboarding doc for "I want to write a
new test in BenchBox" - explain the marker system, the lock, the macOS
quirk, and where to put fast vs slow tests.
description:
Quality plan Phase 4f/4g. AGENTS.md is referenced as the canonical contributor
& agent guide but is only 98 lines - too thin to actually be canonical.
Promote frequently-needed patterns from /docs/development/ into AGENTS.md
so contributors and AI agents have one source of truth.

Separately, tests/conftest.py:52-209 implements a sophisticated file-based
inter-process test lock with a macOS-specific workaround at lines 109-122.
This is undocumented, fragile, and surprises new contributors. Add a
tests/README.md explaining what the lock does, why it exists, and when
the macOS branch fires.

anti_patterns.dont: document the macOS conftest branch by paraphrasing the code
anti_patterns.instead: quote the exact lines (109-122) and explain why

anti_patterns.why: the two will drift out of sync
it stops being a quick reference

preserves.behavior: AGENTS.md remains a quick reference, not a 1000-line tome - target ≤ 300 lines

verifications.command: uv run --with markdownlint-cli2 markdownlint-cli2 AGENTS.md tests/README.md
uv run --with linkchecker linkchecker AGENTS.md tests/README.md
verifications.description: Local cross-links resolve without requiring external network access

work_units.summary: Expand AGENTS.md with 5 sections (+80-120 lines, ≤300 total, ~2h): timing policy, result validation, adapter authoring pointer, dep upper-bounds reference, test markers cheat sheet
Write tests/README.md (~100-150 lines) covering: (a) marker taxonomy, (b) the inter-process lock contract, (c) the macOS conftest branch, (d) how to add a new test category (~2 hours)
Cross-link AGENTS.md ↔ tests/README.md ↔ docs/development/ so the entry points are obvious (~30 min)
